title: A runtime-only load over three registries
teaches: PacerRt resolves PACB target references against the ordered PACT join supplied at load. The join decides each target's name, registry and lane count; the carrier carries only the reference. Here three registries contribute arities 3, 1 and 2 to one flat target space.
observe: mix is registry 0 with three lanes, send is registry 1 with one, extra is registry 2 with two.
The runtime alone loads the carrier; no score text is supplied.
The vec3 mix lane sums beat and the drive control across its components.
The PACM tracks resolve all three host names from the join.
